note: Free public Arbitrum One JSON-RPC endpoints, verified with eth_chainId returning 0xa4b1, a JSON-RPC batch, eth_feeHistory with reward percentiles, a Multicall3 eth_call, an eth_getLogs window of 50,000 blocks, and logs from the first supported deployment. Endpoints that refused eth_getLogs or capped it below that width, needed a key, or were unreachable at verification time are omitted. PublicNode refuses every receipt, and any log window wider than a few dozen blocks, with HTTP 403, so receipts and log windows come from the others. Pocket Network's gateway sometimes routes to a node with a narrower cap, which the adaptive window absorbs. The websocket rows carry the newHeads subscription that wakes a sync pass when blocks land, and each was verified by subscribing and receiving a push. The history API row is the Etherscan v2 multichain service, which serves Arbitrum One under chainid 42161 on its free plan.
